SASBDB entry SASDWZ9  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDWZ9/)

Publication: pH Sensitivity of the SERF1a Conformational Ensemble
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1021/acsomega.5c07620

The publisher's PDF used to be kept in this folder. It was removed from the repository
(size, and the publisher's redistribution terms): fetch it from the DOI above. The
fitting script test/fitting_tests/SASDWZ9/ cites the sections and tables it takes the
buffer and sample conditions from.
